description: Module sets for tools.entrypoints.gc_baseline --load. Use 'bare' for interpreter boilerplate only, and 'core' to compare against the #2852 baseline population.

bare.description: No preload; only interpreter startup objects. Compare runs on one host only.

core.description: Loads the Core application import chain, which is where the tracked-object population comes from. Matches the #2852 'complete load' condition.

http-adapters.description: Core plus the inbound HTTP adapter stack, for comparing adapter-disabled runs against the full set.
